title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 0.4 T (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Rod acceleration magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be 1.2 m/s² (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Force balance setup
description: Important Criteria: For part (1), the student must equate the magnetic force (BIL) with the component of gravity along the incline (mg sin37°).

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the student must apply F_net = ma along the incline, accounting for both gravity and the magnetic force component.

title: Magnetic force direction
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the student must correctly determine that the magnetic force acts horizontally (perpendicular to the new vertical field and current direction).

title: Component resolution
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the student must resolve the horizontal magnetic force into a component along the incline using cos37°.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses incorrect signs for force components along the incline in either part.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student shows consistent use of SI units throughout calculations.
